purpose: Obtain the first real transport and installed-executor discovery evidence without changing the current QuarkSelfAI runtime owner.
architectureChange: add a standalone test-only control-plane listener bound to 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port
add an allowlisted local process discovery adapter for Claude Code, Codex and DSH
send signed no-effect test plans through the loopback protocol into the existing inactive lease/checkpoint contracts
keep the installed compatibility runtime as the sole consumer/provider/writer
allowedActions: use only Node.js built-ins and already-installed repository dependencies
start and stop an ephemeral loopback process during tests
execute only fixed version/help probes for allowlisted Claude Code, Codex and DSH binaries
read exit code, semantic version and bounded authentication availability without retaining command output or executable path
create test.* tenants and synthetic identities in ephemeral test state
transport, verify, lease and checkpoint signed plans with zero allowed effects
commit and push the exact implementation after all gates pass
explicitExclusions: send a prompt to Claude Code, Codex or DSH
invoke any Agent capability or lifecycle handler
install or upgrade any dependency, binary or third-party project
use production tenants, credentials, business messages, customer data or internal identifiers
read workspace files beyond repository fixtures
enable an external write or a live effect provider
change DSH/Cordis or product runtime composition
start or restart the QuarkSelfAI daemon
activate the private Work Integration Pack
switch or duplicate a consumer, provider, scheduler or writer
migrate persistent data or delete any source
validation: unit fixtures for allowlist, redaction, timeout and malformed tool output
real local probe readback for each installed allowlisted executor
real loopback start, signed-plan round trip, disconnect and shutdown test
assert 127.0.0.1 binding and ephemeral test tenant only
private pack audit and root agent sync check

rollback.method: Stop the ephemeral pilot process, then revert the single pilot implementation commit.
